value.body: An ERP functional consultant sets up and supports enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, the systems companies use for accounting, purchasing, inventory and payroll. Commerce graduates usually work on the finance and accounting modules. Employers include IT services firms, ERP implementation partners and companies with in-house ERP teams; a typical day involves understanding a business process, configuring the system to match it, testing, and helping users.

items.note: Direct employees across all IT and tech roles, not only ERP

items.label: B.Com students (regular mode)
items.note: Down from ~38.7 lakh in 2021-22 (AISHE, regular mode)

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers often join as ERP support or associate consultants at IT services firms or implementation partners, or move across from an accounts role in a company that runs an ERP. Vendor certifications are often asked for but can be costly; some employers train freshers in-house.

value.title: At a glance
items: Common next roles: senior consultant, solution architect, finance systems lead.
The core combination is accounting knowledge plus system skills.
Project work can involve client travel and go-live deadlines.
